role: Post-open, zero-new-physics-call failure attribution over the independently sealed v265.1 full-sequence residuals.
scientific_question: For the 229 already sealed K16-matched observation failures of the fixed v265.1 half-ray correction, is the frozen 1.05 cell-gate excess entirely localized to the unselected detector rays, or do the selected and unselected ray blocks both remain deficient?
mechanism_boundary: This is not a new candidate and does not change the v265.1 mask, coefficient, parent, depth, preconditioner, thresholds, controls or call ledger. It only partitions already sealed residual energy into the exact even-quincunx ray block and its exact complement.

energy_definition.selected: Sum of squared residual components over the sealed even-quincunx ray roster.
energy_definition.complement: Sum of squared residual components over every ray not in that roster.
energy_definition.total: selected + complement, checked against the direct full residual squared norm.
energy_definition.two_replica_envelope: For each cell choose the formal or independent candidate replica with the larger total residual energy, breaking an exact tie toward formal; independently choose the K16 replica with the smaller total residual energy, again breaking a tie toward formal. Decompose that exact conservative candidate/reference pair into selected and complement terms.
energy_definition.rig_tail_excess: Use NumPy higher p90 with tau=1.02 and the earliest worst cell with tau=1.05; decompose each violated anchor by the same squared-energy identity.

classes.numerical_cancellation: Any remaining total failure; this invalidates the attribution.

parent_spillover_check: Within each replica, verify the sealed candidate selected residual is nonincreasing from the recreated-v258 parent. Count failures where selected energy falls but complement energy rises; this is descriptive and never selects a new candidate.
decision_order: Any parent seal, identity, shape, finite, roster, selected-trace, energy-conservation, formal-recomputation or formal-independent classification disagreement gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_HALF_RAY_SPILLOVER_ATTRIBUTION_V266.

If all 229 conservative cell failures and every violated complete-rig p90/worst anchor are complement_only, conclude UNSELECTED_RAY_SPILLOVER_SUFFICIENT_FOR_ALL_V265_1_MATCHED_FAILURES_V266 and close the broader class of one-sided selected-ray objectives that never observe their complement.

Otherwise conclude MIXED_SELECTED_AND_UNSELECTED_RAY_DEFICIT_V266, report exact class counts, and keep only the already established fixed-half-ray closure. No new candidate is authorized by either outcome.
